name: Third Church of Christ Scientist and Christian Science Monitor Building
evidence: The congregation opposed designation and then sued the District over it (Third Church of Christ Scientist v. District of Columbia; D.D.C. 2008); resolved by the 2010 ICG/DCPL settlement.

name: 3020 Albemarle Street NW
evidence: Owners opposed the Forest Hills Neighborhood Alliance's application and hired their own architectural historian to argue against it; designation was followed by a lawsuit.

name: West Heating Plant
evidence: Owner appeared before HPRB as a party in opposition; developer Richard Levy called the 5-3 vote 'an unprecedented decision by the board'. Staff report notes the owner had objected to National Register listing in 2015.

name: Washington Animal Rescue League Animal Shelter (71 O Street NW)
evidence: The property is owned and occupied by S.O.M.E., which opposed the nomination; HPRB designated only the street-facing building rather than the whole site staff recommended.

name: INTELSAT
evidence: ANC 3F chair announced the owners had come out against designation; the owner had earlier asked that the case not be heard. Note the GIS layer still shows the site as Pending.

name: Daniel Webster School
evidence: Mayor's Agent order HPA 00-462 recounts NTEU asking HPRB to vacate the designation; HPRB reopened the proceedings over NTEU's objection while keeping its landmark decision. Predates the HPO tables.

name: PEPCO Harrison Street Substation
evidence: Later commentary says it was landmarked over the local ANC's opposition and with criticism from Pepco; no source found that Pepco formally opposed. HPO counts only one owner-opposed approval in FY2018, which West Heating Plant already accounts for.
